claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by setting control-plane architecture for deterministic routing, GraphRAG grounding, runtime gates, and human escalation.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow capabilities with enterprise value realization and usage-based forecasting.
Strengthened regulated AI workflows with audit-grade runtime observability, combining evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls for reliable production execution.

Standardized an AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates from intake through monitoring, using managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design to support repeatable deployment.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data pipelines, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through an operating model for agentic AI and platform productization.
